{{Quote|The security protocols on the AccuTronics are a little dated; anybody with some decent programming skills can make the encryption routine more impressive by slicing into the coding algorithms and change them to a base 12 system from its existing base 10.|Chello, in a note published in Gundark's Gear Datalog|<ref name="Gundark">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>}}
